name: yandex-direct-api
description: Full Yandex Direct API v5 via the local mcp-yandex-direct npm server: statistics, keywords, bids, budgets — including write tools. Sign in with Yandex right in the chat; a ready-made token is optional (for CI). Requires Node.js 20+.

token.title: Yandex Direct OAuth token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to sign in with Yandex from the chat ("connect Yandex Direct"). Set only for CI or headless setups.

client_login.title: Client login (agencies only)
client_login.description: Managed client login for agency tokens; leave empty for a regular advertiser account
